Package com.lemarketjames.reports.period

Class ReportCalendar

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.reports.period.ReportCalendar
@Component public class ReportCalendar extends Object
Turns report days, weeks, months and years into ranges of stored timestamps. A report's "day" is a day in the reports time zone (lmj.reports.time-zone, contract C5), while orders are stored in UTC, so a trade late in the evening in New York belongs to that day even though its UTC timestamp is already on the next one.

Every report endpoint takes its date ranges from here instead of converting time zones itself, so all reports agree on where a day starts. The approach is the one order history uses (buy-sell-service's OrderHistoryPeriod), with the zone coming from configuration instead of the caller.
